citation.authors: Annor E, Pollak M, Ramasamy D

cited_by.title: Childhood trauma and where to start

record.population: 56 studies (40 in the meta-analysis) of cumulative adverse childhood experiences and mental disorders
record.finding: Cumulative ACEs were strongly associated with mental disorders (pooled odds ratio 3.18, 95% CI 2.84 to 3.56) with a dose-response gradient from 1 to 4 or more ACEs. Findings were robust in sensitivity tests with minimal publication bias; the authors call for trauma-informed care and global equity in ACE research.
record.note: Mixed populations; the abstract does not say how many studies were in Black populations. Association, not proof of cause.
